title: Definition of Done Checklist
description: GAP-020 — required artifact of gate-f3 (Successful Build), which until now declared no schema. Records which Definition-of-Done criteria a change met, and — the half that makes it evidence rather than a formality — WHO said so and WHAT they pointed at.

changeSetRef.description: Commit range, pull request or tag the checklist is about. A checklist not bound to a change is unfalsifiable.

code.description: Stable identifier of the criterion, e.g. `tests-pass`, `adr-recorded`, `docs-updated`. Deliberately an OPEN vocabulary: the Definition of Done is the team's, not the engine's (see ADR T-056).

evidenceRef.description: Where to look. Required in practice for a criterion that claims to be met — a tick with nothing behind it is the failure mode this artifact exists to prevent.

waived.description: The criterion was consciously skipped rather than met. Distinct from `met: false`, which is simply not done.

waiverRef.description: The exception that authorises the waiver. A waived criterion without one is an unapproved shortcut.

assertedBy.description: Who signed the checklist. Anonymous completeness is not evidence.
